description: This file defines the interface for CUDA driver API interactions in PyTorch, including error checking macros, version-specific API function declarations, and a DriverAPI struct with function pointers.

classes.name: DriverAPI
classes.description: Struct containing function pointers to CUDA driver API functions and NVML functions, with static methods to access the API and NVML handle.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of DriverAPI with function pointers loaded.

methods.name: get_nvml_handle
methods.description: Returns a handle to the NVML library.
